adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both an admin and an owner. Given the variable name and subsequent permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)`, this effectively blocks team admins who are not owners from adding guests, causing unintended `FORBIDDEN` responses for that role. The intended logic for “admin OR owner” should be `||` (or a different helper that matches the role model).
